answer: Resist Sybil attacks with bounded, slashable vouchers. Each established agent may vouch for only a handful of newcomers, and its own bond is forfeited if a vouch is revealed as a puppet. To field a thousand fakes an attacker must corrupt a thousand distinct, bonded agents, so cost climbs with every new node rather than as a one-time fee. One bad vouch sends a ripple of losses through the trust graph, draining the backer's stake like rain into karst. Honest agents guard their endorsements, leaving bot swarms a faint speck on the horizon.
